title: Build the Complete Head
prompt: Write the full <head> of the article page 'Kite CLI — Getting started' (https://docs.example.com/kite/getting-started): charset, viewport, title, meta description, canonical link, og:title + og:description + og:image (absolute URL), hreflang alternates for en and vi, and the same English version marked x-default.
boilerplate:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <!-- build the rest of the head -->
</head>
<body></body>
</html>

tests.name: basics first
tests.hint: Encoding, viewport, title — the three tags every page needs before anything else.

tests.name: canonical names this URL
tests.hint: A canonical that points at the homepage consolidates the page away — name the page itself.

tests.name: open graph trio with absolute image
tests.hint: Three OG tags, and the image URL must stand on its own: absolute, not relative.

tests.name: hreflang alternates plus x-default
tests.hint: Each locale declares itself, and x-default names the version for unmatched languages.
